title: Mandrake's Potion Shop
description: An elderly wizard with a green scarf and black beret stands behind a wooden desk in a dimly lit arcane study, gesturing with one hand while an open book, glowing potions, and red seals lie before him. The purple-hued room features arched windows showing a full moon, hanging lanterns, shelves of colorful magical potions, constellation charts, and a large painting of a haunted house on the wall.
prompt: An elderly wizard wearing a black beret and green scarf stands behind a cluttered desk in a mystical purple study at night, gesturing with an open hand toward the viewer. The room contains glowing potions in bottles on shelves, hanging lanterns, an open spellbook, red wax seals, a large framed painting of a haunted house under a full moon, and star constellation charts on the walls. Moonlight streams through an arched window. Warm and cool magical lighting, detailed fantasy illustration style.
